{{Top|leg}}
A '''micropole''' was a device [[Riveting gun|fastened]] to the exterior [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Several were generally used at once, depending on the size of the vessel. The micropoles would strengthen the effective density of the ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|defenses]] and cover the spots where the fields did not overlap properly. Unfortunately, there was a correlative increase in the energy they extracted from the ship's [[Power core/Legends|power core]].
